text:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm about to apply a terraform change that converts the worker deployment into a statefulset and adds staggered startup to avoid thundering restart/redis pressure. posting the plan below, want quick eyes on rollout settings before i merge.

maria: terraform diff snippet:
```
  resource "kubernetes_stateful_set" "worker" {
    replicas = 6 -> 6
    pod_management_policy = "Parallel" -> "OrderedReady"
    update_strategy {
      type = "RollingUpdate"
      rolling_update {
        partition = 0 -> 0
      }
    }
    template {
      spec {
        termination_grace_period_seconds = 30 -> 120
        containers {
          name = "worker"
          resources {
            requests { cpu = "200m" 
                       memory = "512Mi" }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
```

maria: main goals: ordered start, longer pre-stop for graceful drain, and avoid simultaneous restarts by enforcing OrderedReady + a startup jitter init. also wiring secretRef for redis creds via k8s secret (no env leaking).

devon: thanks — quick q: why OrderedReady vs Parallel? perf tradeoffs?

maria: OrderedReady ensures pod N is Ready before N+1 starts. with our redis cluster and connection rps, parallel caused spikes during deploys. we only need 6 replicas, so the slower startup is fine.

alex: suggestion: add a randomized startup sleep in the container entrypoint or a initContainer that sleeps between 0-15s to spread connection bursts. also add readinessProbe that checks redis slot mapping rather than just TCP.

maria: good call. plan to add initContainer:
```yaml
initContainers:
- name: startup-jitter
  image: busybox
  command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep $((RANDOM % 15))"]
  env:
  - name: RANDOM
    valueFrom:
      fieldRef:
        fieldPath: metadata.name
```

sam: are we changing podManagementPolicy to OrderedReady in TF only? will this trigger recreate of pods?

maria: statefulset update to podManagementPolicy is in-place for k8s v1.20+ — it won't recreate pods. changing from Deployment->StatefulSet is the big migration and will require careful rollout (we'll scale down the deployment gracefully and scale up the statefulset). plan: set deployment replicas to 0 in a canary job, create sts with partition=6 (so no immediate rollout), then roll partition down by 1 per 30s.

devon: can you add a post-deploy smoke that asserts token-per-second doesn't spike > 1.5x baseline? also ensure autoscaler (HPA) is disabled during cutover so replicas don't wig out.

maria: yep — HPA will be paused (tf null resource that annotates to disable). smoke script will run after each partition decrement.

infra-bot: CI check: terraform plan OK, but warning: secretRef change detected for "redis-credentials" (rotation will be required).

alex: about secrets — please use projected volume with KMS-wrapped secret or reference via secretRef (no plain envFrom). also add annotation to audit who applied the migration.

maria: will use projected secret + annotate with "infra.redwood.com/migrated-by: maria". one more ask: if no objections, i'll merge in ~30m and run the staged partitioned rollout during low-traffic window (03:00 UTC).

sam: lgtm from me, will monitor metrics during rollout.

devon: lgtm — ping here when you kick it off. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — merging in 25m and posting status updates here as i progress.
